scholarships.title: DAAD Study Scholarships - Postgraduate Studies in the Fields of Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film

existing.description: DAAD study scholarship for graduates in the arts to continue their education in Germany with a postgraduate or complementary course in Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film. Funding covers a Master's/postgraduate degree course or a one-year complementary course without degree at a state or state-recognised German university. The scholarship pays a monthly stipend of EUR 992 plus a travel allowance, a one-off study allowance and insurance payments; it does not pay tuition fees. Selection is made by a DAAD specialist committee of professors from German art, design and film schools on the basis of the written application and the artistic portfolio.
eligibility: First university degree in the field of arts
University degree normally not older than 6 years at the application deadline
Full-time, attendance-based study programme (no part-time, extra-occupational or predominantly e-learning study)
Not resident in Germany for more than 15 months at the application deadline
Nationality must be selectable in the DAAD portal together with the applicant's status
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold a first university degree in the field of arts by the time the scholarship starts, the degree should normally not be more than 6 years old at the application deadline, study must be full-time and attendance-based, and the applicant must not have resided in Germany for more than 15 months at the application deadline.
benefits: Monthly rent subsidy in certain circumstances
Monthly allowance for accompanying family members
Subsidy for justified additional costs in the case of a disability or chronic illness
Green Mobility Top Up or reimbursement of carbon offset payments for air travel
German language course of 2, 4 or 6 months before the study programme if necessary
Allowance for a personally chosen German language course during the scholarship period
Reimbursement of the fee for a TestDaF or DSH test
coverage: Payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover
Optional monthly allowance for accompanying family members
Payment of course fees for an online language course after receipt of the Scholarship Award Letter
requirements: All application documents must be submitted in German or English; documents in other languages must be translated
Only PDF files can be uploaded to the DAAD portal
The artistic portfolio must not be uploaded to the DAAD portal - it goes to the DAAD media database via a link sent after the formal check
Late or incomplete applications cannot be considered
The application is only valid if all documents are submitted to both the DAAD portal and the DAAD media database
documents: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form
Form 'Information about your preferred master programmes'
Letter of acceptance from the host university in Germany (if available)
Confirmation of supervision from a German university teacher (complementary studies without degree only)
Current transcript of records with individual grades
All university degree certificates indicating final grades
Proof of proficiency in the language of instruction
Artistic portfolio with samples of work, uploaded to the DAAD media database
existing.english_requirement: Applicants must have the knowledge of the language of instruction of their chosen study programme at the latest by the start of the scholarship; language certificates may not be older than three years.
application_method: Complete the online application and upload the application documents as PDFs
After the formal check, upload the artistic portfolio and supplementary list to the DAAD media database using the link sent by DAAD
existing.selection_notes: A special DAAD committee made up of professors from German art, design and film schools makes the final decision. There is a period of up to seven months between submission of application materials and notification of the selection decision.
existing.best_fit: Graduates in Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication or Film who already hold a first arts degree and need a German art, design or film school as supervisor.
existing.notes: Funding for a Master's or postgraduate degree programme that has already started in Germany cannot be granted. A study period abroad can only be funded if it is essential for the scholarship objective, does not take place in the home country and does not exceed a quarter of the scholarship period.
existing.duration: 10 to 24 months for a Master's/postgraduate degree course; one academic year (usually 12 months) for complementary studies without degree
existing.application_period: Applications for this scholarship programme are possible between 1 June and 15 October 2026
existing.deadline_display: 15 October 2026; the DAAD portal closes at 24:00 hrs (CET/CEST) on the last application day. Selection date in April 2027; funding begins from October 2027.
